metadata.description: A self-hosted, curated registry of AI capabilities.

unsaved.title: Leave without saving?
unsaved.message: Your changes aren't saved. If you leave now, they're lost.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.message: There is nothing at this address. It may have moved, or you may not have access to it.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.message: The page could not be shown. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell the people who run this instance.

cliAuth.title: Use rmk from the terminal
cliAuth.intro: <mono>rmk</mono> installs items from this registry into your AI coding tools, and keeps them up to date.
cliAuth.step1Hint: From npm, with Node.js 22.12 or later (<readme>the README</readme> has more):
cliAuth.step2Tokens: With your email and password, or with a personal token from <tokens>Access tokens</tokens>.
cliAuth.step2Here: With your email and password, or with a personal token from this page.
cliAuth.webHint: Signed up with your company, or using two-factor sign-in? Approve it in the browser instead:
cliAuth.step3Hint: <mono>rmk whoami</mono> says who you are. Every item page shows its install command; the Documentation explains the rest once you're signed in.
cliAuth.globalHint: Outside <mono>global</mono>, an item's name starts with its workspace: <mono>rmk install @workspace/scope/name</mono>.

nameProblem.characters: Use only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
nameProblem.edges: Don't start or end with a hyphen.

authShell.headline: Your team's AI capabilities, curated in one place
authShell.lead: Skills, agents, rules, commands, hooks and MCP servers, reviewed before release and delivered to Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.
authShell.reviewedBody: Every item and change needs an approval.
authShell.installBody: rmk puts items where each tool reads them.
